title: The end-to-end demonstration's judge
note: A demonstration is accepted only when every leg says what a working harness must: the slab decided by the policy, the good FMU VERIFIED, the negative twin REJECTED by the independent check while its own invariants hold, the restart checkpoint-assisted and agreeing with full replay, the second reader clean, the crate clean.

mutations.name: HD1_the_twin_need_not_be_rejected
mutations.rationale: a demonstration whose fault FMU was VERIFIED is accepted

mutations.name: HD2_the_twin_check_need_not_fail
mutations.rationale: the twin can be rejected for a reason other than the independent check failing

mutations.name: HD3_the_twin_may_break_its_own_invariants
mutations.rationale: a fault that its own invariants would catch passes as a test of the independent check

mutations.name: HD4_the_good_fmu_need_not_verify
mutations.rationale: a harness that rejects everything passes the twin test

mutations.name: HD5_the_slab_may_decide_anything
mutations.rationale: the slab decided against the admission policy and the demonstration is accepted

mutations.name: HD6_slab_checks_may_fail
mutations.find: if any(s != "PASS" for s in slab["checks"].values()):
mutations.rationale: an independent check that failed is not noticed

mutations.name: HD7_any_restart_is_accepted
mutations.rationale: a restart that fell back to full replay reads as checkpoint recovery

mutations.name: HD8_reconstruction_findings_are_ignored
mutations.rationale: the second reader's anomalies do not stop the demonstration

mutations.name: HD9_crate_problems_are_ignored
mutations.rationale: an RO-Crate with missing members is packaged as the demonstration's record

mutations.name: HD10_a_smaller_scope_reports_itself_as_the_full_one
mutations.rationale: a run without FEniCSx reports the admission check as run, so an ACCEPTED demonstration of refusal reads as one of admission
